SELECT u.id, u.plan_id AS planId, u.unit_no AS unitNo, u.title, u.scenario_type AS scenarioType, u.summary, u.status, u.core_word_count AS coreWordCount, u.extended_word_count AS extendedWordCount, u.supplementary_word_count AS supplementaryWordCount, u.completed_core_count AS completedCoreCount, u.recommended_date AS recommendedDate, u.scene_material_id AS sceneMaterialId, u.generated_time AS generatedTime, u.started_time AS startedTime, u.completed_time AS completedTime, u.create_time AS createTime, u.update_time AS updateTime, u.deleted, u.version, m.id AS materialId, m.learning_text AS materialLearningText, m.translation AS materialTranslation, m.parsed_json AS materialParsedJson, m.revision_no AS materialRevisionNo FROM learning_plan_unit u LEFT JOIN learning_scene_material m ON u.id = m.unit_id AND m.current_version = 1 AND m.deleted = 0 WHERE u.plan_id = #{planId} AND u.deleted = 0
AND u.id IN
#{uid}
ORDER BY u.unit_no ASC
